name: Biomedical Science PhD
summary: UConn Health umbrella PhD with seven concentration areas and three first-year laboratory rotations.

applicationFee.note: The department offers no waivers. Central waivers cover named affiliations, qualifying UConn enrollment or immediate progression, and US military service. These are conditional, not a general hardship offer; international applicants must confirm an eligible category before relying on a waiver.

english.note: Programme minima exceed central minima. PTE68. Scores valid two years to application; tests taken on/after December1,2026 not considered. Official agency delivery required. TOEFL Essentials/MyBest/ITP (except UConn ITP), IELTS General/Indicator/One Skill Retake excluded. US citizens/permanent residents, primary-English applicants, an entire English-medium non-US degree documented by the Registrar/Controller, or qualifying US graded coursework can be exempt. US coursework requires30 undergraduate/combined or18 graduate credits and GPA3; non-graded courses excluded. TA oral-English rules are separate.

documents: Unofficial university transcripts, or required international third-party evaluations
Two-part personal statement: motivation and significant research experience; two pages total,11-point,single-spaced,1-inch margins,no attachments
requirements.note: Bachelor-equivalent degree and central GPA alternatives:3.0 entire prior degree;3.0 last two full-time undergraduate years or3.5 last year; or3.0 qualifying post-degree semester. International transcript evaluations from NACES/AICE required without exception by deadline, including degree completion. Listed three-year degrees from specified countries are not accepted as four-year equivalent even with evaluation; consult source. One umbrella application only; concentration preference is nonbinding.

funding.note: Program says students in good standing receive GAs throughout; older financial-support page says most entering students. No universal guarantee inferred from this conflict. GA tuition waiver and subsidized insurance; published$39,100/year is undated on a page marked rev9/24, not confirmed Fall2027. Financial-support page requires regular/full-time status and GPA3.0.
